lines.en: My tiny arms hang useless; the teeth do the work.
I patrol the riverbed at an easy pace.
This Madagascar soil is familiar.

lines.zh: 每走几步，我就抬一次头。
lines.en: Every few steps, I raise my head.
My shadow travels with me.
Prints stay behind in the cracked mud.
These little arms have no use.
I catch the smell of old blood.
My tail balances me as I go.
The sea cut that island off.

lines.zh: 岛上的东西，都是本地的。
lines.en: Everything on the island is native here.
I duck low through the brush.
My steps are heavy but quiet.
I work my way up the slope.
I hold my jaws open to cool down.
This stretch is mine.
I am listening to the grass.
The Cretaceous air is heavy.

lines.zh: 我伏在灌木影里数呼吸。
lines.en: I count my breaths in the shade of the brush.
A splinter of bone is stuck between my teeth.
There is nothing else big on this island.
I rock my head slightly.
Across the sea, nothing can come.
The wind carries a jumble of smells.
I crouch and gather myself.
Prey always lets its guard down.
My claws rest folded against my chest.
It is so quiet even the insects stop.
To my eyes, you are meat.
The wind is good where you stand.
I turn my whole head to you.
You are not wearing armour.
I use only my jaws, not my hands.
Your step faltered, and I understood.
Your head would make one bite.
Do not stare into my eyes.

lines.zh: 马达加斯加来的客人，你好。
lines.en: Greetings, guest, from Madagascar.
You will run. I know that.

lines.zh: 我在算你到那边的距离。
lines.en: I am measuring your distance to the trees.
Stand there a little longer.
I roar, and the echo is muffled.
It does not hurt, only gets in the way.

lines.zh: 挨一下，脚还是钉在原地。
lines.en: One hit, and my feet stay planted.
Blood drips from my jaw.
I can bite back.
Who gave you the nerve to come close?
The wound is shallow; I do not care.
All my teeth are still here.
This has only made me hungrier.
I turn my head aside.
Meat? Bring it closer.
This smell sets me on edge.
Toss it over; I will not be polite.
I do not like chasing. I like waiting.
Raw is best, still warm with blood.
Stretch out your hand and I will come.
That will not fill my teeth.
I smell blood.
Do not tremble; the meat will drop.
I eat first. The rest can wait.

lines.zh: 我这身骨头，撞上来很硬。
lines.en: This frame of mine hits hard.
I shove you back.

lines.zh: 这一撞，没挪动我的重心。
lines.en: That impact didn't shift my weight.
My feet slipped a little.
Move - this island has one road.
My teeth graze past your shoulder.
Flesh meets flesh with a dull thud.
I have steadied myself.
That will give you something to think about.
I step around you.

lines.zh: 我吼一声，很远都听得到。
lines.en: My bellow carries a long way.
There are not many of us on this island.
I lower my head and sheath my teeth.
Let us circle each other once.
The sand by the river is soft enough.
First see whether the water is clear.
Our young must survive on this island.
I touch my snout to your neck.
Half this hunting ground is yours.
One blood, one river.
One snap and I have it.
I carry it off to eat later.
This bone is too small.
That carcass belongs to my jaws.
Crunch it, then swallow.
If it is not meat, I leave it.
One toss of my head and it splits in two.
Not much flavour, but edible.
Some scraps are left on the ground.
Bone grit in my teeth - perfect.
You shifted your feet.
Now you are prey.
I drop my whole head low.
Your only way out is the river.

lines.zh: 汗里的盐味顺着风来了。
lines.en: The salt of your sweat rides the wind.
Claws? No use.
I do not intend to miss this bite.
I sink low and coil.
Locked on - I'll start at the ankles.
This bite is decided.
You are in the shade; I am outside it.
My teeth click together.

lines.zh: 你这步法我听过太多回。
lines.en: I've heard that gait too many times.
This is the bite.

lines.zh: 你每枚脚印我都踩一遍。
lines.en: I set my feet in every print you leave.
Glance back and I am there.
Our shadows are nearly touching.
I can be patient.
My head stays pointed at you.

lines.zh: 你踩过的草还没直起来。
lines.en: The grass you stepped on is still bent.
When you stop, I speed up.
There is no second one like me on this island.
I circle without rushing the bite.
My teeth are clicking.
Changing direction will not help.
My tail sweeps the ground.

lines.zh: 我给你留了条路，你没走。
lines.en: I left you a way out. You did not take it.
Fewer than ten steps.
My breathing grows heavier.
Blood spurts between my teeth.
I tear with a single bite.
This is my only weapon.
You are thrown to the ground.
I wrench my head and fling you off.
My teeth catch in your armour and stick.
A dull crack; bone gives way.
I let go and step back.

lines.zh: 你血里的味道，我记住了。
lines.en: I will remember the taste of your blood.
I tear a second time.
These little arms are no help.
I bring my full weight down.
You slipped that one.
You can still stand?
I step out of the brush.

lines.zh: 白垩纪的岛，搬到这儿了。
lines.en: The Cretaceous island has come here.
A new row of deep prints appears.
My shadow passes over the grass tops.
The teeth show first.
This place smells like hunting ground.

lines.zh: 马达加斯加的孤岛，我没了。
lines.en: My lonely island is gone.
I am here, and very hungry.
A low growl rolls across the sand.
A layer of dust lifts.
Not much health, but the teeth will serve.

lines.zh: 骨骼堆在脚下的记忆，还在。
lines.en: I still recall the bone heaps underfoot.
Nobody comes near this river.
Across the sea, I can find no way back.
I lift my head and sniff the air.
Are you ready or not.

lines.zh: 很多双眼睛会盯着我的头骨。
lines.en: Many eyes will be after my skull.
I stroll over step by step.
Flame licks my scales and I pull back.
I land hard and my leg bones jar.
Water pours into my jaws and I thrash.
The blast flips me right over.
That thing is stuck in my shoulder.

lines.zh: 这股力不在我的世界里。
lines.en: This force does not belong in my world.

lines.zh: 岛上没猎物了，我也撑不久。
lines.en: No prey left on this island; I will not last.
Lightning strikes my back, and I snarl.

lines.zh: 下方空无一物，我掉进去。
lines.en: Nothing below me, and I fall in.
